We capture context from your daily life -- meetings, messages, browsing, notes -- and use it to help you remember everything, prioritize your day, and solve real problems. Think of us as the AI assistant that actually knows you. Check out the recent TechCrunch news on our $11M seed funding and what users are saying about the product. We're growing fast, and we're entering a phase where gut instincts need to be backed by rigorous data. That's where you come in. The Role We're looking for a sharp, stats-literate Analyst who can own product analytics end-to-end. We need someone with the judgment to know what questions to ask and the rigor to answer them properly. Generative AI can write SQL. It can calculate p-values. What it can't do is design the right experiment, catch a subtle confound in your cohort analysis, or connect a qualitative user signal to a quantitative pattern. That's the job. You'll work closely with our C-suite and product leadership to drive decisions on retention, engagement, conversion, and experimentation. What You'll Do Own experimentation. Design A/B tests with proper sample size calculations, power analysis, and significance testing. Run them. Interpret them. Flag when results are misleading. Analyze retention and engagement. Build and maintain cohort analyses, retention curves, and conversion funnels. Identify what separates users who stick from users who churn. Answer the hard questions. "Does Meeting Notes drive paid conversion, or do power users just happen to use it?" -- that kind of thing. Correlation vs. causation is your bread and butter. Define and track metrics. Help us build the right metrics framework for our stage. Know when a metric is vanity and when it's signal. Communicate findings clearly. Present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders in a way that drives action, not confusion. Use LLMs as a force multiplier. We expect you to use AI tools aggressively for query generation, data wrangling, and visualization -- so you can spend your time on the thinking, not the typing. What We're Looking For Must-haves: 3-5 years of experience in product analytics, data analysis, or a quantitative role at a tech company (startup experience strongly preferred) Strong statistical foundations: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, Bayesian reasoning, power analysis, regression. Not textbook knowledge -- practical application. Demonstrated ability to design and analyze A/B tests and other controlled experiments Sharp product intuition -- you think about why users behave a certain way, not just how Excellent written and verbal communication Nice-to-haves: Fluent in SQL. You'll be writing HogQL (ClickHouse-flavored SQL) against PostHog, so comfort with analytical SQL dialects is important. matches.d: This role sits within the Marketing Operations team and is a key enabler of a significant product transformation initiative. The Business Analyst will work directly in support of the Product Owner to drive the delivery of an agentic, conversational AI-powered tool designed to modernize and streamline marketing campaign intake, requirements creation, and campaign execution workflows. The successful candidate will serve as the connective tissue between business stakeholders and technology teams — translating marketing operational needs into precise, actionable requirements that fuel sprint-by-sprint delivery. This is a high-engagement role requiring someone who is equal parts rigorous analyst, collaborative partner, and detail-obsessed executor. This role is ideal for a professional who thrives in ambiguity, brings genuine intellectual curiosity about emerging AI capabilities, and is motivated by the opportunity to help shape how marketing campaigns are conceived, scoped, and brought to life through cutting-edge technology. Because this product is novel in concept and execution, the ideal candidate brings not just analytical discipline but also the creative and adaptive thinking needed to define problems and solutions that don't yet have established playbooks. Development Opportunities ●First-hand experience building and launching an enterprise-grade AI/agentic product from the ground up ●Deep cross-functional exposure spanning Marketing Operations, Technology, Risk, Legal, and Finance ●Opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of MarTech, workflow automation, and conversational AI ●Visibility to senior leadership across marketing businesses and functions ●Long-term career paths across technology product and marketing operations domains Key Responsibilities Requirements & User Story Development Own the end-to-end coordination of all requirement packages to be handed off to Technology, ensuring completeness, clarity, and traceability Draft detailed technical requirements, well-structured user stories, and robust acceptance criteria for assigned workstreams Translate complex business and marketing operational needs into unambiguous, developer-ready specifications Proactively question and pressure-test requirements with stakeholders to surface gaps, edge cases, and unstated assumptions Agile Delivery Support Attend and actively contribute to all grooming sessions, ensuring backlog items are refined, estimated, and sprint-ready Support sprint planning and release planning activities in close partnership with the Product Owner and Scrum Master Review and sign off on sprint deliverables, validating that implemented features meet defined acceptance criteria Track and communicate sprint readiness status and flag risks or blockers to the Product Owner in a timely manner UAT & Quality Assurance Draft comprehensive UAT scripts and test scenarios that reflect real-world user journeys and edge cases Coordinate and facilitate UAT and usability testing sessions with business users and key stakeholders Document, triage, and manage defect logs; work with Technology to drive resolution prior to release Tool Migration & Change Management Support Support the migration of existing marketing programs and workflows into the new agentic tool platform, ensuring continuity and accuracy of business processes Contribute to the development of change management materials, training documentation, and user guides to enable smooth adoption Assist in coordinating training sessions and communications for impacted business users Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration Partner closely with marketing operations, technology teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to gather, validate, and refine business requirements Facilitate working sessions and workshops to drive alignment on scope, priorities, and solutions Maintain clear, structured documentation of decisions, open items, and action registers Qualifications Experience 6–9 years of experience in a Business Analyst, Product Analyst, or related role within financial services or a comparably complex regulated industry Demonstrated experience in marketing operations or marketing campaign management environments, with a working understanding of campaign intake, execution workflows, and MarTech tools (e.g., Aprimo or comparable platforms) Experience working on workflow tool implementations or digital product builds , preferably involving process digitization or automation Proven track record of writing high-quality user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements in an Agile/Scrum delivery model Experience contributing to the build or launch of AI-powered, agentic, or conversational tools is highly desirable — including defining how AI interactions should behave, drafting prompt-adjacent logic flows, or writing requirements for ML/NLP-driven features Experience working in environments where the product or process did not yet exist — where the candidate helped define the "what" and "how" from scratch rather than incrementally improving an established system Technical & Functional Skills Functional technical literacy sufficient to engage meaningfully with engineering teams; ability to understand system integrations, APIs, data flows, and AI/LLM-driven system behaviors at a conceptual level — or demonstrated ability to rapidly acquire such knowledge Proficiency in Agile tools such as Jira for backlog management and sprint tracking Strong capability in requirements documentation tools and productivity suite (Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Visio, Confluence or equivalent) Experience with UAT planning and execution , including writing test scripts and managing defect tracking Familiarity with workflow automation platforms or enterprise SaaS tools is a plus; hands-on experience with AI-powered, conversational, or agentic tools — either as a builder, analyst, or power user — is a strong differentiator Comfort engaging with concepts such as prompt design, conversation flows, agent behaviors, and AI output validation even without a deep engineering background Core Competencies Critical thinking & analytical rigor: Ability to dissect ambiguous business problems and translate them into structured, precise requirements; comfortable challenging assumptions and asking the difficult questions to extract better information Meticulous attention to detail: Maintains high engagement and work quality throughout repetitive, process-intensive tasks without sacrificing thoroughness Independent working style: Able to take direction from the Product Owner and execute with limited hand-holding; self-manages workload and proactively identifies what needs to be done First-principles thinking: Demonstrates the ability to step back from conventional approaches and reason from the ground up — particularly valuable when building products where no direct precedent exists; not constrained by "how things have always been done" Intellectual curiosity & AI aptitude: Genuinely excited by the possibilities of AI and automation; stays informed on emerging capabilities and proactively considers how they could be applied to solve real business problems in Job Overview: As a Technical Project Manager at CAI, you will coordinate people and processes to ensure that our projects are delivered on time and produce the desired results. Technical Literacy: Solid fundamental understanding of back-end systems, complex, fully automated data flows, and computing technologies. System Debugging: Familiarity with reviewing server/application logs to track down software bugs or data pipeline failures. Preferred Qualifications Experience with Jira and Confluence for project tracking and documentation. Exposure to incident management, production support, or operational troubleshooting environments. Experience reviewing logs, debugging issues, and supporting root cause analysis. Production Support: Prior experience working in high-pressure incident management, site reliability, or production troubleshooting teams. matches.d: Product Analyst Overview The Product Analyst – Legacy Platform Modernization supports an assessment, requirements, solutioning, and AI-enabled prototyping effort to modernize a federal client's legacy loan servicing platform, migrate its capabilities to a modern enterprise platform, and plan the full decommissioning of the legacy environment. Working with the product lead and product managers, the analyst performs current-state analysis, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, capability assessments, and gap analysis; facilitates requirements workshops; and documents functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, and future-state processes for each loan servicing capability. The analyst maps integrations, dependencies, and data flows from source to screen, supports legacy function disposition analysis and evaluation of modernization and decommissioning alternatives, and contributes to AI-assisted analysis and prototyping. Success requires excellent written and verbal communication, strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to shift priorities, leadership amid ambiguity, and proficiency with the Microsoft Suite. Key Functions Support the product lead and product managers with the legacy platform modernization assessment across the Requirements and Solutioning workstreams. Perform current-state analysis of the legacy platform, including its servicer portal, supporting databases, reporting services, external servicer integrations, and manual operational processes. Conduct stakeholder interviews and help plan and facilitate value stream sessions and requirements workshops with federal client business stakeholders, IT teams, and subject matter experts. Document current-state business processes and create process maps, customer journey maps, UI mockups/wireframes, and future-state process flows. Elicit and document functional and non-functional requirements (technical, operational, performance, security, and data access) for each loan servicing capability, including general and delinquent loan servicing, servicing quality reviews, claims processing, collections, loan purchase requests, property acquisitions, and post-audit reviews. Create epics, features, user stories, business rules, data mapping, and definitions of reports and communications, maintained in Jira and Confluence. Complete capability assessment checklists covering applications and tools in use, adjacent business processes, upstream and downstream integrations, correspondence and document services, shared services, and risks and constraints. Build integration and dependency maps and analyze application and business domain data requirements, understanding the data flow from source to screen. Identify requirements gaps, duplicate functionality, outdated requirements, and hidden business rules, and support legacy function disposition analysis (migrate, retire, automate, consolidate, defer, or replace). Support evaluation of modernization and decommissioning alternatives, including sequencing options, trade-offs, and implementation options analysis. Use approved AI-assisted tools to accelerate discovery, analysis, and documentation, including reverse-engineering requirements from legacy code and prototypes. Identify automation and process improvement opportunities, and capture employee performance and workforce considerations for impacted functional areas. Create high-quality client deliverables, such as requirements packages, assessment findings, and presentation materials, with regular supervision from the team lead. Be a good teammate to the client and the delivery team, encouraging and enabling teammates to be their best selves. Maintain positive relationships with the client. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree and 5 years of relevant experience. An additional 2 years of experience with an Associate's Degree. An additional 4 years of experience with a high school diploma. Experience with requirements elicitation and documentation, including user stories, business rules, and non-functional requirements. Experience with current-state analysis, process mapping, and gap analysis. Excellent verbal and written communications skills. Strong attention to detail with proven analytical and problem-solving skills. Can easily shift focus between high-priority tasks as required. Demonstrates leadership in the face of ambiguity, rather than waiting for direction from above. Navigates through challenges to consistently get things over the finish line. Proficiency with Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Preferred Qualifications or Skills Experience supporting federal loan servicing or benefits-delivery applications and legacy system modernization or migration efforts. Existing Public Trust clearance at a federal agency. In-depth knowledge of the mortgage industry, particularly loan servicing, loss mitigation, default, foreclosure, and claims processes. Familiarity with MISMO data standards and servicer reporting. Experience implementing Salesforce and/or AWS solutions for the federal government. Experience using AI-assisted tools for analysis, requirements, or documentation. Experience using JIRA and Confluence. matches.d: This role sits in the Product Management team within Sage Technology, the department responsible for building and maintaining the systems that run our business. You will report into Product Management and work alongside other product owners, product managers, engineers, and architects across the technology estate. Your product is Microsoft Dynamics CRM, and your internal customers are our college textbook sales and journal advertising sales divisions. Dynamics is where their pipeline is managed, customer relationships are tracked, and revenue decisions get made. You own the backlog for that platform and you are accountable for making it genuinely better for the people who depend on it every day. This is a role for a technologist with real commercial awareness. You will spend your time between two worlds: out in the business understanding what is slowing sales teams down, and back with your delivery team turning that into work that ships. Because Dynamics sits at the center of several business processes, you will also manage dependencies with other product teams inside Sage Technology. What you will do Own and prioritize the product backlog, making clear decisions about sequencing and trade-offs, and keeping the roadmap connected to both business objectives and the wider technology strategy. Build strong relationships with your internal customers in textbook sales and journal advertising sales, translating their needs into well-defined, valuable work for the delivery team. Lead discovery and validation. Talk to users, interrogate the data, and test assumptions before committing engineering effort. Partner closely with engineers and architects in Sage Technology, developing enough technical understanding of the platform to anticipate delivery risks and shape feasible solutions. Manage competing priorities and cross-team dependencies within the technology estate, negotiating openly when demands conflict and keeping stakeholders aligned on what is happening and why. Define what success looks like, then measure it. Use adoption data, performance metrics, and user feedback to judge whether changes actually worked. Contribute to the Product Management team's own practice, supporting your delivery team's agile ways of working and mentoring colleagues in good product habits. What you will bring 3-5 years of experience as a product owner, product manager, or in a comparable role, with hands-on responsibility for a backlog. If your experience sits slightly outside that range but you can show the capability, we would still like to hear from you. A track record of writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and running effective refinement with a delivery team. Strong stakeholder management. You can hold your ground with senior people, say no with a reason, and keep relationships intact. Confidence working with data to inform prioritization, and the critical thinking to question what the numbers are actually telling you. Experience working in agile delivery teams, ideally with colleagues in multiple locations and time zones. Genuine curiosity about the business you support and the users you serve. Preferred Requirements Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, or with another CRM platform such as Salesforce or HubSpot. Background in publishing, higher education, media, or advertising sales. Experience with system integrations, data migration, or the wider Microsoft Power Platform. Experience supporting teams through changes in process or tooling. Illness already asks enough of us. xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people. xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from. Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful. We are building for the lives people want to live. matches.d: About Pearl Founded in 2013, Pearl is a ratings and standards company building the national standard for home performance. Pearl SCORE™ rates every single-family home in the U.S. across five key pillars — Safety, Comfort, Operations, Resilience, and Energy — so homebuyers, homeowners, and real estate professionals can understand how a home performs in daily life. Today, the value of a home is judged by its location, size, and aesthetics— but these factors overlook the home’s most important function: safeguarding the comfort, well-being, and finances of the people inside. Most American homes underperform in these regards because home performance is simply not on our radar. We can’t see it, quantify it, or put a value on it. Pearl aims to change that by making home performance a central part of how we view and value our homes. We are not a home inspector, a contractor, a real estate platform, or a green-certification program — we rate homes against a transparent, evidence-based standard so that home performance becomes visible, measurable, and valuable in the real estate market. As a Certified B Corporation, we're accountable not only to our shareholders, but also to the homeowners and communities we serve. For more information, visit . Job Description reputed company's Product Management team is adding a Product Analyst for Prism. Prism is our conversational analytics platform. It lets the people who work in market access at life sciences companies ask questions about their data in plain English and get answers back in seconds, instead of handing the request to an analyst and waiting. Behind the scenes, Prism runs on semantic layers we build from our raw SQL data, and those layers are what let it take a business question and map it to the right numbers. The Product Analyst is the person who makes sure the questions people ask actually line up with the answers Prism gives back. You'll work day to day with Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering to keep those answers accurate and worth trusting. This isn't a development role, and it isn't about building reports or dashboards. It's an analysis role for someone who is technical but isn't a software engineer. You'll use reputed company reputed company along with tools like Claude and Codex to review and improve the prompts business users type into Prism and the answers it sends back. A lot of the work is finding the spots where the data is set up in a way that leads Prism to misread a question or return the wrong answer. Roughly half the job is digging into the data itself. The other half is talking to the business owners, certifying that queries return the right results, and writing up what needs to reputed company. What This Role Entails Prompt review Go through the prompts business users type into Prism and improve them, using reputed company reputed company and tools like Claude and Codex, so their questions get read correctly against the semantic layer. Query certification Check user queries and the answers Prism gives back, confirm they hold up against the source data, and sign off so the business can trust the results. Quality ownership Keep an eye on the questions users ask and the answers they get, and watch for repeat errors, gaps, or misreads so they get fixed. Semantic layer work Work with Data Science and Engineering to improve the semantic layers built from the raw SQL tables, including the taxonomies, metadata, and labeling, so Prism understands the data better. Data analysis Dig into how data connects across pricing, rebates, chargebacks, and other areas, and use what you find to shape how that data is represented in Prism. Working with the business Talk to business owners about the questions they need answered, and turn those conversations into better prompts, queries, and data structure. Writing requirements Write clear technical requirements for tuning the model, changing how data is structured, or reputed company the product, based on what your reviews turn up. Documentation Document where the data comes from, the business logic behind it, and how things relate, so people can understand and trust Prism's answers. Roadmap input Be the voice for data quality in planning and prioritization for Prism, so decisions are based on what the data actually says. QA and communication Work with QA to set up test reputed company for answer accuracy each sprint, and help with internal and customer updates (release notes, briefings, presentations) that explain how Prism works. Qualifications What You'll Bring to the Table At least 3 years in data analysis, data correlation, or similar analytical work. Strong technical skills without being a software engineer. You're comfortable with SQL, semantic layers, and data structures, and you can dig into a problem on your own. Hands-on experience with AI tools like reputed company reputed company, Claude, or Codex, and a good sense of how they read structured data and prompts. A working knowledge of semantic data modeling (ontologies, taxonomies, knowledge graphs, or similar) and how it supports AI querying. A knack for spotting when an AI answer doesn't match the source data, and the patience to figure out why. A track record of turning messy data relationships into clear requirements, working alongside Product Management, Data Science, and Engineering. Strong writing and speaking skills. You can talk to business owners and explain complicated data and AI ideas in a way people can act on. Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile tools. Role overview Our client is an Australian technology company whose AI voice agent platform answers and handles phone calls for businesses in Australia and New Zealand. As a Product Analyst , your responsibility is to research the AI voice agent market and turn it into clear, build-ready feature documents for our client's development team. This role is the bridge between the market and the product. You will study what competitors offer, analyse what the platform should build next, and write specifications the CTO can act on. The Founder & CEO makes final decisions on what gets built. Business owners create their own AI agents that can answer questions, book appointments, collect caller details, send SMS messages and transfer calls to staff. The platform is fully self-serve: customers set up and manage their agents, and handle any escalated calls themselves. The platform is built on its own technology stack using leading speech and language AI models, and is designed to work across industries. Key Responsibilities Market and competitor research Identify and track AI voice agent and call-handling platforms, globally and in Australia and New Zealand. Sign up for competitor free trials, build test agents and call demo numbers to experience their products first-hand. Monitor competitor feature releases, pricing changes, integrations and new market entrants. Feature analysis Break down how competitors design and deliver specific features, including user flows, settings and limitations. Assess which features are standard expectations and which could set the platform apart. Research third-party integrations (CRMs, calendars, booking systems, helpdesks) and how they connect to voice agent platforms. Feature documentation Write clear, structured feature specification documents using the client's standard format. Present feature documents to the Founder & CEO for review and approval. Hand approved specifications to the CTO and answer the development team's questions about them. Keep a prioritised feature backlog up to date. Platform insight Review anonymised call transcripts and recordings to spot where agents struggle or callers get confused. Analyse platform usage data, such as feature adoption and drop-off during agent setup. Review support tickets and cancellation feedback for recurring issues and feature requests. Product quality Test new features once built against the approved specification and report gaps. Help maintain product documentation and help-centre content for new features. Requirements Skills and Experience Essential 1–3 years in a product analyst, business analyst, QA or similar role at a software or SaaS company. Excellent written English, with the ability to write clear, structured documents for both business and technical readers. Strong research and analytical skills, with a habit of testing products hands-on rather than relying on marketing pages. Ability to understand software features and user flows, and explain them simply. Confident using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT for research, analysis and drafting. Organised and self-directed, able to manage several research topics at once and meet agreed deadlines. Reliable home internet and a quiet workspace suitable for remote work. Desirable Familiarity with AI voice agents, chatbots or conversational AI products. Basic understanding of APIs and how software integrations work. Work Environment & Expectations While this is a work-from-home position, it is important to note that this is a full-time role—not a freelance or flexible-hour arrangement. You will be expected to work a fixed shift and maintain a high level of professionalism and accountability, just as you would in an office environment. ✅ This role requires: Discipline and commitment to set working hours (strict shift times, not flexible) Use of time tracking software during work hours Active participation in team and client calls with your camera ON Consistent availability and responsiveness throughout your shift Treating this as a long-term, full-time job—not a side gig or freelance task ⏱Payroll is processed bi-monthly. matches.d: Job Description A bit about this role: Devoted Health engages in millions of member interactions every year through a frontline organization of team members and AI agents spanning Member Service, Specialty Care Coordination, and Member Outreach, Sales and more. The quality of those interactions is the mission. Every call, every outreach, every touchpoint is a moment where we either earn or lose a member's trust. Getting this right at scale requires a fundamentally new approach. You will build AI systems that monitor the quality of every member interaction and turn those signals into coaching and feedback that elevates both frontline team performance and frontline AI agent performance. You will define what high performance looks like across these teams and AI agents and build the systems that ensure we hit our goals. You will be a close thought partner to the leaders of our frontline teams, ensuring that every tool you build is adopted and helps them meaningfully improve performance. This is a new role, and you will shape what AI-native quality and performance operations looks like for this organization. Your Responsibilities and Impact will include: Embed with frontline teams and their leaders to understand what quality looks like in practice: how members are engaged, where interactions break down, and how coaching happens (or doesn't) today. Own the performance of our highest volume frontline AI agents, across voice and chat, and continue to build out those agents to drive higher performance. Build AI-powered quality monitoring systems that move the needle on our most important business outcomes. Evaluate member interactions in real time across millions of touchpoints, moving beyond pass/fail scoring to nuanced assessment of what actually matters for member experience, safety, and outcomes. Build coaching workflows that surface actionable feedback to leaders at all levels immediately, making every interaction an opportunity to improve. Every key stakeholder should have an approach to action on results so that we’re getting better every day. Visualize interaction data, evaluation criteria, coaching signals, and performance trends so the right insight reaches the right person at the right time, from rep to team lead to senior leader. Scale what works. Turn successful systems into reusable frameworks that extend to new teams, interaction types, and channels. What works for Member Service should accelerate what you build for Specialty Care Coordination, Member Outreach, and our Clinician orgs. Partner closely with frontline team leaders across levels, coaching them on how to use the tools you build, ensuring adoption, and iterating in real time in response to their feedback to drive value. Oversee a small team of operators and agent builders that will drive performance across all frontline agents and teams Required skills and experience: 4+ years in high-ownership operator roles: startup strategy, biz ops, consulting, or internal tooling PM. You have built and run systems that made organizations meaningfully more effective, and you move quickly to working prototypes on real data with real feedback. People leadership experience: you have directly managed, mentored, or grown individuals or teams, and you bring that lens to every cross-functional partnership. You know how to build trust quickly, give feedback that lands, and create the conditions for people around you to do their best work. Fluency with modern AI tools and platforms, with an active practice of pushing their limits. You're adaptive and curious — willing to learn, teach, lead, and follow. Strong data fluency: You self-serve analysis and reason from data rigorously: you know which numbers actually drive the business, can spot when a metric is misleading, and turn ambiguous data into clear insights on quality. Systems thinking: you move from solving a single issue to designing a framework that prevents an entire category of issues. You generalize your work and think in feedback loops, not isolated fixes. An instinct for quality in human interactions: you translate intuition about what a good member experience feels like into structured criteria an AI system can apply at scale. You care deeply about doing what's right for members and the teams serving them. A coaching and enabling mindset: you work with frontline managers and quality leads to ensure AI-generated insights actually change behavior. You challenge assumptions, do what makes sense even when it's unconventional, and care more about outcomes than credit. Exceptional communication: you tailor your style to move teams to action, from frontline guides to executives. You're comfortable with ambiguity and take ownership of outcomes end to end. Built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, our applications help customers improve visibility, efficiency, and operational scalability. Overview Leads the design, development, testing, release, and support of complex Business Central and cross-platform mobile solutions. Serves as a technical leader by making sound design decisions, mentoring developers, resolving difficult technical problems, and improving engineering quality and delivery practices. What This Position Owns Visioning and Competitive Intelligence (20%): Shape domain direction using market signals, customer insight, and competitor analysis; propose strategic bets, positioning updates, and sequencing changes tied to business outcomes. Backlog and Sprint Readiness (15%): Own backlog health by prioritizing and preparing work so items are sprint-ready with clear scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and delivery sequencing. Stakeholder and Cross-Team Alignment (10%): Align Product, Engineering, Support, Sales, and Implementation on priorities, timing, tradeoffs, and customer commitments so execution and messaging remain consistent. Customer Discovery and Validation (15%): Engage users and customers, including dispatchers, technicians, and service managers, to validate problems, test assumptions, and convert learning into better priorities and requirements. Solutioning and Tradeoff Work (10%): Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options and make practical decisions across customer value, effort, risk, scalability, and time to value. Escalations and Issue Triage (10%): Lead or coordinate priority customer and product issue response, including triage, decision-making, stakeholder communication, and prevention actions that reduce recurrence. Quality Validation and Platform Release Readiness (10%): Confirm product behavior through UAT support, regression validation, and release-impact checks; stay current on major platform releases and features to protect compatibility and identify product opportunities. Documentation Review and Enablement Readiness (5%): Verify release documentation is accurate, complete, and usable across customer-facing guides, internal support notes, and enablement materials. KPI Review and Outcome Tracking (5%): Monitor adoption and service-performance metrics, interpret outcome trends, and feed learning back into roadmap and backlog decisions. How Success Is Measured Success is measured by backlog health and sprint readiness; quality of product decisions and cross-team alignment; validated customer learning; timely resolution of priority issues; release quality and platform compatibility; documentation readiness; feature adoption; service-performance trends; and measurable movement in product and business outcomes. Responsibilities Build and maintain a fact-based product-domain perspective using customer feedback, support patterns, market signals, competitive research, platform changes, and performance data. Propose product bets, positioning changes, and roadmap sequencing updates with a clear connection to customer and business outcomes. Own and continuously prioritize the backlog based on customer value, strategic fit, revenue impact, risk, technical health, effort, and time to value. Translate priorities into sprint-ready work with clear problem statements, scope, user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and sequencing. Lead backlog refinement and provide timely product decisions before and during development. Plan and conduct discovery with relevant users and customers, document findings, test assumptions, and incorporate validated learning into requirements and priorities. Partner with Engineering to evaluate solution options, understand technical constraints, and make explicit tradeoff decisions. Align Support, Sales, Implementation, Product, and Engineering on priorities, timing, customer commitments, release impact, and messaging. Lead or coordinate triage for priority product and customer issues, including decision-making, stakeholder updates, and prevention follow-up. Support UAT, regression validation, and release-impact reviews to confirm that product behavior meets expectations. Monitor major Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and related platform releases for compatibility risks and product opportunities. Approve completed work against acceptance criteria and intended customer outcomes before release. Review customer-facing documentation, internal support notes, release communications, and enablement materials for accuracy and readiness. Monitor adoption and service KPIs, interpret trends, and use the findings to adjust roadmap, backlog, discovery, and enablement decisions. Strong capability in customer discovery, competitive analysis, requirements definition, backlog management, facilitation, stakeholder communication, issue triage, UAT, and data-informed decision-making. Experience with SaaS, ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and rental, service, field-service, or industrial-asset workflows is strongly preferred. matches.d: Role Description Merge medical imaging solutions, offered by Merative, combine intelligent, scalable imaging workflow tools with deep and broad expertise to help healthcare organizations improve their confidence in patient outcomes and optimize care delivery. Merge is one of the most widely deployed medical imaging platforms in the world. Radiologists and cardiologists rely on us to store, move, and read imaging studies across enterprise health systems, teleradiology reading centers, and community hospitals. We are modernizing the portfolio for the cloud and building empowered product teams that own outcomes — and this role builds the operating model and design foundation those teams run on. This is an enabling-function leadership role with three connected parts: • Product Operations: How product gets built and run — the product development lifecycle, program management, the operating cadence, and the tooling and data that keep everyone working from one source of truth. • AI Enablement: How we make that lifecycle faster and sharper — using AI to accelerate funnel development, build and pressure-test business cases, and prioritize where the org spends its capacity. • UX: Product design, user research, and the design system that make the reading experience consistent, usable, and clinically sound. You will report directly to the VP, Product, and lead across all three — serving every product team rather than owning a single product. What you’ll own • Operating model and cadence. • Program management. • Tooling and data. • AI enablement and AI-accelerated PDLC. • Design and research (UX). What you’ll do • Standardize the product development lifecycle and operating cadence so teams discover, build, and ship consistently — with AI embedded in how the org works. • Use AI to accelerate funnel development — shortening the path from raw opportunity to validated, scoped, ready-to-build work. • Build the business-case discipline — AI-assisted market sizing, evidence, and ROI so investment decisions are fast, consistent, and defensible. • Own how the portfolio gets prioritized — a transparent, evidence-backed model for ranking work and reallocating capacity as the evidence changes. • Lead program management across the portfolio and give leadership a clear, current view of progress and risk. • Own the product toolchain and portfolio metrics; resolve friction so teams work from one source of truth. • Lead and grow the UX team, and evolve a design system that keeps the experience coherent across products. • Run the early-access and customer-advisory motion that brings clinician feedback into the product early. • Build, coach, and retain a team spanning operations and design. Qualifications • 8+ years across product operations, program management, and/or design leadership, including running cross-functional operating models. • Experience standardizing a product development lifecycle and operating cadence for multiple teams. • Hands-on experience embedding AI into how product teams discover, build, and ship — and using it to speed up the funnel, business cases, and prioritization. • Program and release management skill — you make dependencies, risk, and progress visible and keep initiatives on track. • Design and research leadership — you have led or partnered closely with UX and owned or grown a design system. • Fluency with product tooling and metrics, and a bias toward one source of truth. • People leadership and clear, plain communication with product, engineering, design, and executives. Nice to have • Background in healthcare, medical imaging, or another regulated domain. • Experience with AI-assisted research, synthesis, or evaluation tooling in a regulated environment. • Familiarity with quality management systems (QMS) and regulated software development.
